videos.headline: North Texas QB throws pick-six
videos.description: Mean Green's Mason Fine throws an interception to the Owls' Nicholas Sorensen, who takes it to the house for a 75-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Mean Green's Smith runs up the seam for TD
videos.description: North Texas' Nic Smith receives the hand-off and runs up the middle for a 13 yard touchdown.

videos.headline: North Texas' Fine breaks school record with long TD pass
videos.description: Mean Green's Mason Fine heaves the ball to Rico Bussey who cradles it in for a touchdown. Fine breaks North Texas' single-season record with 27 touchdown passes.

videos.headline: Owls' Stewart carted off field
videos.description: Rice's Samuel Stewart is carted off the field after getting hit on a short carry.

videos.headline: Rice's QB runs in 52-yard TD
videos.description: Miklo Smalls runs the ball 52 yards and dives for the pylon for an Owls' touchdown.

videos.headline: Rice's QB throws INT in 4th
videos.description: Owls' Miklo Smalls' pass is intercepted off a deflection and caught by Green Machine's Eric Jenkins.
